browser_failure_recovery_matrix.result: Seven exact-commit browser cases passed: reload recovery in the originating encounter; quota exhaustion preserves committed chunks; lost upload response retries from the committed 4 MiB offset; identical file uploads to distinct encounters; a late microphone denial cannot stop a newer capture; authorization revocation stops recording; and server-acknowledged prefixes remain recoverable. Device unplug and slow-storage backpressure cases also passed in the shared 11-case run.

runtime.runner: Playwright 1.64.1, headless Chromium 157, Node 22.16.0, local loopback frontend/API
limitations: Permission changes, device unplug, and tab reload were induced synthetically in Chromium; real operating-system permission and hardware unplug behavior still needs device validation.
